# IP Quality Test · 1ms.dog

> Free IP quality check. Asks 18 keyless IP intelligence sources (Cloudflare, ip-api.com, IPQuery, ipapi.is, IPinfo, ipwho.is, IP.SB, iplocation.net, GeoJS, RDAP (RIR), ip.guide, Shodan InternetDB, Tor Project, 1ms public lists, SANS ISC, RIPEstat, AlienVault OTX, Reverse DNS) and
> 9 DNS blocklists about an address, then gives a 0–100 score (A–F), whether it is residential or data
> center, native or broadcast (registered country vs. location), VPN/proxy/Tor flags, and what that means for
> streaming, AI services, CAPTCHAs, sign-ups and sending mail. Each source's answer is shown with a link to check it.
> 6 more sources need an API key (proxycheck.io, IP2Location, IPQualityScore, AbuseIPDB, Scamalytics, ipdata); the live 1ms.dog site does not enable them.

- Page: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Any address or hostname: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/?ip=8.8.8.8
- Up to 20 addresses at once, as one table: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/batch/
- API (NDJSON stream, one line per source, then the score; add &format=json for one document): https://ipqs.1ms.dog/api/check?ip=8.8.8.8
- OpenAPI: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/openapi.json
- Source code: https://github.com/yt1988/ip-quality-test

- More 1ms.dog tools: https://1ms.dog/
